messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from a rear three-quarter angle. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the described camera setup and movement, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to an upper-body shot from a rear three-quarter angle. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands mostly still facing away from the camera, then briefly raises her right arm to touch her hair before lowering it.","camera":"A static medium shot from behind the subject at roughly waist height.","clothing":"She wears a short, colorful dress with a purple, blue, orange, and red pattern and an open back.","hair_color":"Dark reddish-brown hair.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled back into a low ponytail at the nape of the neck.","identity":"A slim woman with a low ponytail, seen from behind, with a bare back and shoulders.","scene":"An outdoor amusement park or boardwalk area with a carousel, a covered pavilion with string lights, and a small red cart on a sandy ground under bright daylight."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output now shows the woman from behind in a medium upper-body framing at an amusement park, matching the reference's rear three-quarter view and subject placement. Her hair appears dark reddish-brown in a low ponytail rather than the source's bright pink, and the dress pattern differs from the source's multicolored abstract print. The arm-raising action occurs later in the output than in the source, and the scene was changed from a bare sandy area to a boardwalk with a carousel, pavilion, and red cart.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to an upper-body shot from a rear three-quarter angle, using the reference for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and action timing.
uncertain: Whether the final framing is intended as an upper-body shot or a medium shot
unexpected_changes: Hair color changed from bright pink to dark reddish-brown
Hairstyle changed from loose pink hair to a low ponytail
Dress pattern changed from the source's abstract multicolored print to a paisley/floral pattern
Scene changed from a bare sandy area to an amusement park boardwalk with a carousel, pavilion, and red cart
Action timing shifted; the arm raise occurs later in the output than in the source
